name: Destroy Actor
description: Removes an actor from the level, marking it pending kill so it is no longer rendered, ticked, or collidable. Memory is reclaimed later by garbage collection.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The actor to destroy. Connect a Get reference, a Spawn Actor output, or any valid actor reference.

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the actor is marked for destruction.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: True if the actor was successfully destroyed. False if the destroy call was rejected (for example during level transitions).
